findings.summary: LLVMCAS missing pthread linkopts; CMake passes ${LLVM_PTHREAD_LIB} via LINK_LIBS
findings.evidence: CMake lib/CAS/CMakeLists.txt:30: LINK_LIBS ${LLVM_PTHREAD_LIB}. Bazel CAS BUILD has no linkopts block

findings.summary: LLVMCore (lib/IR) missing pthread linkopts; CMake passes ${LLVM_PTHREAD_LIB} via LINK_LIBS
findings.evidence: CMake lib/IR/CMakeLists.txt:91: LINK_LIBS ${LLVM_PTHREAD_LIB}. Bazel IR BUILD has no linkopts block

findings.summary: LLVMSupport and LLVMPlugins missing -ldl linkopts on Linux; CMake appends ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS} to system_libs; dlopen-based plugin loading will fail to link
findings.evidence: CMake lib/Support/CMakeLists.txt:53: set(system_libs ${system_libs} ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS}). Neither LLVMSupport nor LLVMPlugins BUILD.bazel has linkopts=["-ldl"]

findings.summary: LLVM_ENABLE_ABI_BREAKING_CHECKS hardcoded to 1 for all build types; CMake ties it to WITH_ASSERTS (OFF for Release)
findings.evidence: abi-breaking.h.cmake:19 substitutes LLVM_ABI_BREAKING_CHECKS option defaulting to WITH_ASSERTS; Bazel write_file unconditionally emits #define LLVM_ENABLE_ABI_BREAKING_CHECKS 1 for all three config arms

findings.summary: LLVM_ENABLE_IO_SANDBOX hardcoded to 1 for all build types; CMake option defaults to ${LLVM_ENABLE_ASSERTIONS} (OFF for Release)
findings.evidence: CMake: option(LLVM_ENABLE_IO_SANDBOX ... ${LLVM_ENABLE_ASSERTIONS}); Bazel write_file emits #define LLVM_ENABLE_IO_SANDBOX 1 unconditionally

findings.summary: LLVM_ENABLE_LLVM_EXPORT_ANNOTATIONS and LLVM_ENABLE_LLVM_C_EXPORT_ANNOTATIONS unconditionally defined; CMake sets both OFF by default (ON only for DYLIB/shared/plugins)
findings.evidence: CMake lines 1113-1122: both OFF initially, ON if LLVM_BUILD_LLVM_DYLIB OR LLVM_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OR LLVM_ENABLE_PLUGINS. Bazel unconditionally emits both #defines, changing ABI annotation decorators in static builds

findings.summary: LLVM_ENABLE_PLUGINS unconditionally defined; CMake defaults it OFF for non-PIC/non-DYLIB configurations
findings.evidence: CMake lines 1104-1111: default ON only for ELF+PIC; OFF for Windows/Apple static builds. Bazel unconditionally emits #define LLVM_ENABLE_PLUGINS

findings.summary: LTO missing pthread linkopts; CMake passes ${LLVM_PTHREAD_LIB} via LINK_LIBS
findings.evidence: CMake lib/LTO/CMakeLists.txt:16: LINK_LIBS ${LLVM_PTHREAD_LIB}. Bazel LLVMLTO BUILD has no linkopts or pthread dep

findings.summary: LLVMProfileData missing OpenCSD linkage and HAVE_OPENCSD define; CMake adds opencsd deps under LLVM_ENABLE_OPENCSD; ETMTraceDecoder.cpp code path silently dead
findings.evidence: CMake lib/ProfileData/CMakeLists.txt:73-81: if(OPENCSD) target_compile_definitions(HAVE_OPENCSD) + opencsd link. Bazel has neither dep nor define

findings.summary: LLVMSupport missing zlib linkage; CMake conditionally adds ZLIB::ZLIB under LLVM_ENABLE_ZLIB; Compression.cpp calls zlib functions and will fail to link
findings.evidence: CMake lib/Support/CMakeLists.txt:25 appends ZLIB::ZLIB to LINK_LIBS. Bazel LLVMSupport_cxx has no zlib dep

findings.summary: LLVMSupport missing zstd linkage; CMake conditionally adds zstd under LLVM_ENABLE_ZSTD; Compression.cpp will fail to link
findings.evidence: CMake lib/Support/CMakeLists.txt:28 appends zstd_target to LINK_LIBS when LLVM_ENABLE_ZSTD. Bazel has no zstd dep

findings.summary: 19 of 20 LLVM backend targets absent from Bazel: CMake default LLVM_TARGETS_TO_BUILD=all; Bazel has BUILD.bazel only for X86. AArch64, AMDGPU, ARM, AVR, BPF, CSKY, DirectX, Hexagon, Lanai, LoongArch, M68k, Mips, MSP430, NVPTX, PowerPC, RISCV, SPIRV, Sparc, SystemZ, VE, WebAssembly, XCore source dirs present but no BUILD.bazel
findings.evidence: CMake lib/Target/CMakeLists.txt:34 foreach(t ${LLVM_TARGETS_TO_BUILD}); LLVM_ALL_TARGETS at llvm/CMakeLists.txt:571 lists all 20; find elements/llvm/lib/Target -name BUILD.bazel yields only 7 files all under X86/. lib_Target_headers cc_library exposes headers from all backends but no cc_library build targets exist for non-X86

findings.summary: LLVMIntelJITEvents, LLVMOProfileJIT, LLVMPerfJITEvents have no BUILD.bazel; CMake adds them conditionally under LLVM_USE_INTEL_JITEVENTS, LLVM_USE_OPROFILE, LLVM_USE_PERF
findings.evidence: CMake lib/ExecutionEngine/CMakeLists.txt:33,43,47. Source files exist in elements/llvm/lib/ExecutionEngine/ subdirs but no BUILD.bazel

findings.summary: LLVMTestingSupport and LLVMTestingAnnotations (lib/Testing/*) have no BUILD.bazel; both are library deps used in unit tests throughout LLVM
findings.evidence: CMake lib/Testing/Support/CMakeLists.txt:8 and lib/Testing/Annotations/CMakeLists.txt:8. Source files present in Bazel dirs but no BUILD.bazel

findings.summary: InstrumentorVariables.inc is a frozen static copy of InstrumentorRuntimeHelper.h in Bazel rather than a live file(READ) substitution; future edits will diverge silently
findings.evidence: CMake include/llvm/CMakeLists.txt:7-12: file(READ .../InstrumentorRuntimeHelper.h ...) then configure_file(@ONLY). Bazel write_file carries a frozen verbatim copy

findings.summary: LLVMAnalysis HAS_LOGF128 define unconditional in Bazel; CMake uses check_cxx_symbol_exists to detect logf128 and only defines it when present; silently miscompiles on platforms without logf128
findings.evidence: CMake lib/Analysis/CMakeLists.txt:191-194: check_cxx_symbol_exists(logf128 math.h HAS_LOGF128); define only if present. Bazel Analysis BUILD unconditionally includes HAS_LOGF128 in both LLVMAnalysis_cxx_0 and LLVMAnalysis_cxx_1

findings.summary: LLVMDebuginfod missing pthread linkopts; CMake unconditionally appends LLVM_PTHREAD_LIB on Unix
findings.evidence: CMake lib/Debuginfod/CMakeLists.txt:3: imported_libs=${LLVM_PTHREAD_LIB}. Bazel has no linkopts or pthread dep

findings.summary: Install layout incomplete: only LLVM-Config.cmake installed in Bazel; CMake also installs LLVMConfig.cmake, LLVMConfigVersion.cmake, LLVMExports.cmake, and all *.cmake helper modules
findings.evidence: CMake cmake/modules/CMakeLists.txt:169-185: four install() calls. Bazel install_files__lib_cmake_llvm has only srcs=[cmake/modules/LLVM-Config.cmake]

findings.summary: LLVMDebugInfoPDB: DIA SDK sources and DIASDK::Diaguids linkage absent; CMake conditionally includes 18 DIA/*.cpp files under LLVM_ENABLE_DIA_SDK
findings.evidence: CMake lib/DebugInfo/PDB/CMakeLists.txt:6: 18 DIA/*.cpp files + DIASDK::Diaguids dep. Bazel PDB BUILD has no DIA source glob, no dep, no select()

findings.summary: LLVMHTTP missing libcurl and httplib linkage; CMake conditionally adds both under LLVM_ENABLE_CURL/LLVM_ENABLE_HTTPLIB; HTTP client functionality silently stub-only
findings.evidence: CMake lib/HTTP/CMakeLists.txt:2-7: CURL::libcurl and httplib::httplib. Bazel LLVMHTTP deps has only LLVMSupport

findings.summary: LLVM_ENABLE_ONDISK_CAS hardcoded to 1; CMake defaults ON only when flock(2) is available or WIN32
findings.evidence: CMake HandleLLVMOptions.cmake:1611-1616 sets default OFF, ON if HAVE_FLOCK OR WIN32. Bazel emits #define LLVM_ENABLE_ONDISK_CAS 1 unconditionally

findings.summary: LLVM_ENABLE_TELEMETRY hardcoded to 1 with no Bazel opt-out; CMake exposes it as a user-settable option
findings.evidence: CMake llvm/CMakeLists.txt:927: option(LLVM_ENABLE_TELEMETRY ... ON). Bazel write_file bakes #define LLVM_ENABLE_TELEMETRY 1 with no select()

findings.summary: LLVM_LINK_LLVM_DYLIB build mode not modelled in Bazel: no shared libLLVM target, no select(), DISABLE_LLVM_LINK_LLVM_DYLIB opt-out on TableGenBasic/Common not enforced
findings.evidence: CMake utils/TableGen/Basic/CMakeLists.txt:11: DISABLE_LLVM_LINK_LLVM_DYLIB annotation. Bazel BUILD.bazel notes LLVM_LINK_LLVM_DYLIB=OFF but has no cc_shared_library target, no select() arm, no per-target annotation

findings.summary: LLVMCAS missing AIX-specific 'bsd' system library; CMake conditionally adds it on AIX
findings.evidence: CMake lib/CAS/CMakeLists.txt:1-3: if(UNIX AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME MATCHES AIX) set(additional_libs bsd). Bazel CAS BUILD has no select() for AIX

findings.summary: LLVMTargetParser missing SunOS 'kstat' system library; CMake conditionally adds it on SunOS
findings.evidence: CMake lib/TargetParser/CMakeLists.txt:12-14: if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME MATCHES SunOS) set(system_libs kstat). Bazel TargetParser BUILD has no select() for SunOS

findings.summary: LLVMAnalysis ConstantFolding.cpp missing MSVC /fp:except compile option; Bazel only has -ftrapping-math with no Windows/MSVC platform select()
findings.evidence: CMake lib/Analysis/CMakeLists.txt:31-34: if(MSVC) set_source_files_properties(ConstantFolding.cpp /fp:except). Bazel LLVMAnalysis_cxx_1 has only -ftrapping-math unconditionally

findings.summary: LLVMTargetParser -Werror=global-constructors guard absent from Bazel copts; CMake conditionally adds it to detect accidental static initializers
findings.evidence: CMake lib/TargetParser/CMakeLists.txt:7-9: if(HAS_WERROR_GLOBAL_CTORS AND NOT LLVM_HAS_NOGLOBAL_CTOR_MUTEX) adds -Werror=global-constructors. Bazel copts has no equivalent

findings.summary: LLVMAnalysis TF-AOT generated ML sources absent from Bazel; CMake conditionally compiles TF-AOT model sources under LLVM_HAVE_TF_AOT
findings.evidence: CMake lib/Analysis/CMakeLists.txt:1-18: if(DEFINED LLVM_HAVE_TF_AOT) tf_find_and_compile() populates GeneratedMLSources. Bazel Analysis BUILD has no configurable srcs or genrule for ML model sources

findings.summary: LLVMAnalysis TFLite (tensorflow-lite::tensorflow-lite) linkage absent from Bazel; CMake conditionally adds it under LLVM_HAVE_TFLITE
findings.evidence: CMake lib/Analysis/CMakeLists.txt:20-24: if(LLVM_HAVE_TFLITE) list(APPEND MLLinkDeps tensorflow-lite::tensorflow-lite). Bazel Analysis BUILD has no tensorflow-lite dep
